pubcol-w-30c653c7b5962057.definition_en: a formal letter written by someone who knows you, describing your abilities and character to a potential employer
pubcol-w-30c653c7b5962057.example_simple: My old boss agreed to write a reference letter for my new job.

15928c0c-527b-408d-92d3-c1b957b23458.definition_en: an automatic, involuntary reaction to a stimulus

pubcol-w-7ab1ff05c03b8c61.definition_en: concerning or connected with a particular subject or thing

pubcol-w-9649007e163d3f01.definition_en: the way in which people, groups, or countries behave towards and deal with each other
